title: to ... (I want to do) and -ing (I enjoy doing)
summary: После одних глаголов ставим **to + глагол** (want to do), после других — **-ing** (enjoy doing), а после like/love/start возможны оба варианта.
ru:
## Глаголы + to + глагол
После некоторых глаголов следующий глагол ставится с **to**: **want, need, plan, decide, hope, expect, offer, promise, refuse, learn, forget, try**.
> What do you **want to do** tonight? — Что ты хочешь делать вечером?
> Tina has **decided to sell** her car. — Тина решила продать машину.
> I **forgot to switch off** the light. — Я забыл выключить свет.
> My brother is **learning to drive**. — Мой брат учится водить.
> I **tried to read**, but I was too tired. — Я пытался читать, но слишком устал.

## Глаголы + -ing
После этих глаголов нужен **-ing**: **enjoy, mind, stop, finish, suggest**.
> I **enjoy dancing**. — Мне нравится танцевать.
> I don't **mind getting up** early. — Мне нетрудно рано вставать.
> Has it **stopped raining**? — Дождь перестал?
> She **suggested going** to the cinema. — Она предложила пойти в кино.
- ~~I enjoy to dance.~~ → I enjoy **dancing**.

## Глаголы, после которых можно и то и другое
После **like, love, hate, prefer, start, begin, continue** допустимы оба варианта, смысл почти не меняется.
> I **like getting up** early. = I **like to get up** early.
> It **started raining**. = It **started to rain**.
> Ann **loves dancing**. = Ann **loves to dance**.

## would like / would love / would prefer + to
После **would like, would love, would prefer, would hate** — только **to + глагол**.
> Julia **would like to meet** you. — Юлия хотела бы с вами познакомиться.
> I'd **love to go** to Australia. — Я бы очень хотела поехать в Австралию.
> **Would** you **like to sit** down? — Хотите присесть?
- ~~Would you like sitting down?~~ → Would you like **to sit** down?

## Типичные ошибки
В русском после «хочу», «люблю», «закончил» всегда идёт инфинитив. В английском придётся запомнить, какой глагол требует какую форму.
- ~~I want going home.~~ → I want **to go** home.
- ~~She finished to write.~~ → She finished **writing**.
en:
## Verbs + to ...
Some verbs are followed by **to + verb**: **want, need, plan, decide, hope, expect, offer, promise, refuse, learn, forget, try**.
> What do you **want to do** tonight?
> Tina has **decided to sell** her car.
> I **forgot to switch off** the light.
> My brother is **learning to drive**.
> I **tried to read**, but I was too tired.

## Verbs + -ing
Some verbs are followed by **-ing**: **enjoy, mind, stop, finish, suggest**.
> I **enjoy dancing**.
> I don't **mind getting up** early.
> Has it **stopped raining**?
> She **suggested going** to the cinema.
- ~~I enjoy to dance.~~ → I enjoy **dancing**.

## Verbs with -ing or to ...
After **like, love, hate, prefer, start, begin, continue** you can use both.
> I **like getting up** early. = I **like to get up** early.
> It **started raining**. = It **started to rain**.
> Ann **loves dancing**. = Ann **loves to dance**.

## would like / would love / would prefer + to
After **would like, would love, would prefer, would hate** we use only **to**.
> Julia **would like to meet** you.
> I'd **love to go** to Australia.
> **Would** you **like to sit** down?
- ~~Would you like sitting down?~~ → Would you like **to sit** down?

## Common mistakes
- ~~I want going home.~~ → I want **to go** home.
- ~~She finished to write.~~ → She finished **writing**.
structure:
## Какая форма после какого глагола
| Группа | Глаголы | Форма |
|---|---|---|
| to + глагол | want, need, plan, decide, hope, expect, offer, promise, refuse, learn, forget, try | I want **to go**. |
| -ing | enjoy, mind, stop, finish, suggest | I enjoy **swimming**. |
| to или -ing | like, love, hate, prefer, start, begin, continue | I like **cooking** / **to cook**. |
| только to | would like, would love, would prefer, would hate | I'd like **to go**. |

## Отрицание
> I decided **not to go**. · I don't mind **waiting**. · I wouldn't like **to be** late.

## Правила написания -ing
| Правило | Пример |
|---|---|
| Глагол на -e → -e отпадает | make → making |
| Одна гласная + одна согласная → удвоение | stop → stopping, run → running |
| Остальное: + -ing | enjoy → enjoying |

exercises.title: to или -ing?
exercises.instruction: Поставьте глагол в скобках в правильную форму: **to do** или **doing**.

items.text: What do you want {{to do}} tonight? (do)
They plan {{to visit}} Spain next year. (visit)

exercises.title: Дополните предложения
exercises.instruction: Поставьте глагол в скобках в нужную форму.

items.text: Would you like {{to have}} some tea? (have)
My sister suggested {{going}} to the beach. (go)
I'd love {{to see}} your new flat. (see)

items.q: I'd like ___ a glass of water.

items.why: После start можно и to, и -ing.

exercises.title: Составьте предложения
exercises.instruction: Составьте предложение. Поставьте глагол в нужную форму (to ... или -ing).

answers: I enjoy cooking for my friends.
She decided to buy a new phone.
She has decided to buy a new phone.
We have finished working at six.
Would you like to come with us?
He suggested going for a walk.
He suggests going for a walk.

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Допишите предложения о себе. Проверьте по образцу.

items.sample: I want to learn to drive.
I don't mind getting up early.
Next year I plan to travel to Turkey.
I'd love to have my own café.
